ns0:svg.ns0:desc: Left: initial fraction 0.5, detachment 1 per second, attachment 1 then 3 then 0 per second on consecutive one-second intervals; the state remains continuous at rate changes. Right: initial zero, rates 3 and 1 versus 6 and 2 per second. Both approach attached fraction 0.75; doubling both rates halves the relaxation time.
ns0:svg.ns0:title: Attachment protocols and timescale comparison
